VVL_07_1001.Asset__Description: A rounded evergreen mound with large billows, in the manner of the hand drawn shrubs. The everyday planter shrub.

VVL_07_1002.Asset__Description: A rounded evergreen mound with large billows, in the manner of the hand drawn shrubs, with no grass tufts at its foot. The everyday planter shrub where the bed should read clean.

VVL_07_1011.Asset__Description: A taller, looser shrub with a broken outline: smaller clumps, leaf tips on the edge and deep notches. Lifts the rhythm of a planter run.

VVL_07_1012.Asset__Description: A taller, looser shrub with a broken outline: smaller clumps, leaf tips on the edge and deep notches, with no grass tufts at its foot. Lifts the rhythm of a planter run.

VVL_07_1021.Asset__Description: A low spreading mass for long planter beds, with strap leaf tufts at its foot. Its proxy stretches to the bed: the length changes how many clumps it has, never how big they are.

VVL_07_1022.Asset__Description: A low spreading mass for long planter beds, with no strap leaf tufts at its foot. Its proxy stretches to the bed: the length changes how many clumps it has, never how big they are.

VVL_07_1031.Asset__Description: A soft ornamental shrub carrying big round flower heads over its leaves: a loose mound with bold circles in the outline and through the middle, for a border or a large planter.
